name: manual_8846ef
claim: Keep the model and effort policy in two tiers and encode it in code with tests. Preferred paid models (Claude Fable 5.2 high and GPT-6 Astra high for the outer seat, Claude Opus 5.5 medium and GPT-6.1 Sol medium for the AutoResearcher seat) are human-gated and run only on an exact True approval. The default ladder medium, else high, else low, never xhigh or max, runs automatically on free W&B turns and as the no-paid-permission fallback. The CLI aliases claude-ultra (default effort max) and codex-ultra (default effort ultra) break the rule and must not be used.
conditions: model effort policy human-gated default ladder xhigh max aliases

decisions.notes: 2026-11-17: operator clarification; plan_turn and default_wandb_turn plus tests encode it; the live model list from the ai-cli tool showed the two aliases and their default efforts.
